licences.DEFECT_FOUND: The value {value} was produced by {defect}; a versioned corrected computation gives {corrected} (descriptive).
licences.ESTIMATOR_ARTIFACT/NON_INVARIANT: The registered designed β estimator is not invariant for {predictor}; the designed placebo cannot certify specificity in its current form.
licences.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NOT_REPLICATED: {model}'s predictions differ between the two orderings of the registered {family} census (β = {beta_d3}, reproduced through a verified pipeline): a real response of this model on the registered prefixes. It did not replicate on {n} unused prefixes ({b_label} = {b}, {level} % interval [{lo}, {hi}], below the 0.10 margin and not above 0).
licences.UNEXPLAINED/WEAK_REPLICATION:positive: On {n} unused prefixes {model}'s {family} order response is positive but below the 0.10 placebo margin: {b_label} = {b} (interval [{lo}, {hi}]; lo > 0). It is not exact commutativity and not absence of order sensitivity.
licences.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/ZC_COORDINATE: {model}'s next-cue predictions differ between the two orderings of the registered W2 family and of its loop-sign variants on {n} unused prefixes, unlike {k} of the other seven commutative controls on W2 (|β_W2,PP^fresh| ≤ 0.10{exceptions}). When the loop directions are reversed, the response reverses sign (r_MM = {r_mm}, interval below 0) relative to the NA oracle's contrast (r_PM = {r_pm}, r_MP = {r_mp}, intervals {intervals}), which the NA contrast itself does not do. This is the pattern of an order-dependent Z₃ counting error. On W2 such an error is projected onto the NA contrast, because NA's x-first answer equals ZC's answer and NA's y-first answer equals ZC's answer with one crossing missed. The stage-1 placebo failure is therefore read as a control-specific order error made visible by the W2 geometry, not as NA-direction order use by ZC-s1 and not as a pipeline artefact.
licences.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NOT_NA_DIRECTION: {model}'s W1 response replicated on {n} unused prefixes and reverses sign when both crossings are reversed (r_MM = {r_mm}, interval below 0), so it is not an NA-direction response. W1's members differ in one visited vertex, so this pattern fits an order-dependent Z₃ counting error or an order-free token-identity effect; W1 cannot separate the two. The four NA models' W1 r_v values are printed beside the cell.
licences.UNEXPLAINED/NOT_NA_INVARIANT: {model}'s response replicated (β_PP = {beta_pp}) and is not invariant to loop-sign reversal (r_v = {r_values}, intervals {intervals}), but it does not reverse sign when both loops are reversed; it matches neither the NA oracle nor a sign-symmetric Z₃ counting error.
licences.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NA_DIRECTION: {model} shows an order response on {family} aligned with the NA oracle's composition and invariant to loop-sign reversal on {n} unused prefixes (r_v intervals inside (0.5, 1.5)); it is not explained by sign-symmetric Z₃ counting errors. Its source is unidentified.
licences.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NA_DIRECTION:W1_suffi: The four NA models' W1 r_v values are printed beside the cell.
licences.UNEXPLAINED/PARTIAL: {model}'s response replicated (β_PP = {beta_pp}), but its loop-sign ratios were neither clearly NA-invariant nor clearly Z₃-covariant ({intervals}); a sign-invariant component of up to {upper} cannot be excluded.

not_licensed.DEFECT_FOUND: Any change to the X6S1 outcome. Whether X6S1's technical-correction path applies (protocol §3 row 3, §12 item 3) is the owner's decision (§10).
not_licensed.ESTIMATOR_ARTIFACT/NON_INVARIANT: Any statement about the trained controls' behaviour
not_licensed.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NOT_REPLICATED: "Estimator artefact", "chance", or that ZC-s1 is commutative on designed inputs in general
not_licensed.UNEXPLAINED/WEAK_REPLICATION:positive: Any mechanism; "the placebo failure was noise"
not_licensed.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/ZC_COORDINATE: How ZC-s1 computes (no mechanism, probe or intervention); that the NA models' designed statistics are free of other artefacts; anything about retrained models; any change to rule 9
not_licensed.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NOT_NA_DIRECTION: "Order use" by the control; a Z₃ mechanism specifically
not_licensed.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NA_DIRECTION: "Leak", "NA knowledge" or "learned S₃ composition"; any statement about the NA models

follow_up.ZC_NOT_COMMUTATIVE/NA_DIRECTION: This triggers a provenance audit (a token-content check of the model's training batches beyond LOSS-ECHO's first-batch losses), which needs its own go-ahead.

amendments.1: A Z₃ control is not a clean placebo for an NA contrast with this coupling. Drop it as a designed placebo, or gate it on β_sb = ½(β_PP + β_MM), which is 1 for q*_NA and 0 for sign-symmetric Z₃ errors (validated by K3 and the Stage-C control values). This is supported by K0 and the W1 data whatever Stage C gives.
amendments.2: Put the β and ρ bars on one scale (|β| ≤ √ρ), or gate on ρ relative to the NA models.
amendments.3: Give the designed placebo a prefix-cluster interval and a per-control known-case check (working rule 5); use larger or fresh prefix sets.
amendments.4: The sign-variant discriminator works for Z₃-type controls only: AB is sign-invariant like NA (a = a⁻¹), so AB-type errors could mimic NA_DIRECTION. On bag-unmatched families (W1), it cannot separate counting from token-identity effects.

reuse.amendment_1_inconclusive_mark: supported by algebra and W1 data; Stage C inconclusive
reuse.statement: the W2/W1 pipeline may be reused as a behavioural contrast with explicit empirical controls. It must not be described as automatically excluding every predictor trained on a commutative process.
